name: ArchivePro
tagline: A multi-format archiver — zip/7z/tar/zstd with encryption and split volumes.
description: Create and extract ZIP, 7z, TAR, GZ and Zstandard archives with a familiar dual-pane browser; add AES-256 encryption and password protection, split into volumes, test integrity, and set compression levels. A capable, fully open-source 7-Zip/WinRAR alternative.
